def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # A uniform nonzero line separates two panels; overlay their filled cells.
    div_row = next((r for r, row in enumerate(grid)
                    if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != 0), None)
    if div_row is not None:
        top, bottom = grid[:div_row], grid[div_row + 1:]
        return [[2 if a != 0 and b != 0 else 0 for a, b in zip(ra, rb)]
                for ra, rb in zip(top, bottom)]
    div_col = next((c for c in range(w)
                    if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1
                    and grid[0][c] != 0), None)
    if div_col is None:
        raise ValueError('no separator')
    left = [row[:div_col] for row in grid]
    right = [row[div_col + 1:] for row in grid]
    width = min(div_col, w - div_col - 1)
    return [[2 if left[r][c] != 0 and right[r][c] != 0 else 0
             for c in range(width)] for r in range(h)]
